submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE transparent full-body EAST spell-casting animation frame 09 of 16 for 04 mountain guardian boy.
Input 1 is the current corrected casting sprite and the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact character design, body part dimensions, hand-painted finish, clothing details, equipped objects, full-length staff, global sprite scale and canvas framing. Image 2 verifies character identity only. Image 3 is authoritative EAST side-profile idle including anatomical hands and the closed staff-head backing plate. Image 4 is the approved art/material style only, never copy UI or another face.
Change the edit target into this ONE genuinely new drawing and pose: Just before release peak: right arm extends farther forward while maintaining a soft elbow bend; hand at shoulder height and slightly below peak release. Torso leans forward 7 degrees, forward right knee accepts weight; rear left leg braces. Long staff tilts about 25 degrees forward, middle grip and lower shaft toward shins clearly visible. Tassel lags back softly.
Invariants: strict EAST side profile looking screen-right with one visible eye; stocky round chibi boy, brown ponytail and olive ribbons, amber eye, gold forehead mark, brown prayer beads, warm gold armor over ivory cloth, jade braid waist with lion buckle, brown gold boots. Anatomical RIGHT near-camera hand grips the middle of the original LONG staff. LEFT forearm carries the jade-gold shield on the far side, edge/partial visibility as appropriate. Never swap hands. Staff length is constant, about 85% of standing character height, with equally substantial shaft portions above and below the midpoint hand grip; lower shaft continues well below sleeve toward shins/boots, never a short wand. Large round staff head is the CLOSED OPAQUE GOLD BACKPLATE seen in E idle, with relief: no transparent gaps in this large disc. Only the separately hanging small jade ring has a transparent hole. Preserve top spike, lower pointed cap and gold tassel.
Native square canvas at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Full figure and all staff/shield/ornament parts inside canvas with margins. Preserve camera, global scale and root x50%; virtual ground at y90.625%. Allow anatomical weight shifts; do not rescale by bounding box or pull every foot pixel to a line. Both feet and knee/ankle structure must read clearly, shoulder/elbow/wrist continuous, fingers visibly wrap shaft. No second pose, duplicates, labels, grid, floor, shadow, particle, orb, projectile or baked spell effect. No blur, extra limbs, finger/shaft detachment or plastic toy shine.
